_comment: Accepted Semgrep findings (contrib/semgrep/README.md, 'Accepting a finding'). findings: fingerprint -> {rule, path, reason, by, date}. rule_paths: [{rule (glob), paths (globs), reason, by, date}]. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can check.

0a8e3e80bc0115c4.reason: REMOVED_PATH_RE's repeated group (?:\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)* starts each repetition with a literal '.', so there is one way to match and no catastrophic backtracking; its input is a removed-field path from the repository's own plan, not untrusted text.
